title: All Unitaries Have Constant Depth Quantum Circuits
summary: It is well-known that every $n$-qubit unitary can be implemented by a $2^{O(n)}$-depth quantum circuit using single- and two-qubit gates. It has been open whether exponential depth is *necessary* for general unitaries, even when allowing an unlimited number of ancilla qubits. Here we show, perhaps surprisingly, that all unitaries can be implemented exactly by a circuit of one- and two-qubit gates of depth $\mathsf{poly}(n)$ with $2^{O(n)}$ ancilla qubits.
